columns.name: RecordId
columns.description: Unique identifier for each user record.

columns.name: RecordName
columns.description: The name of the user record.

columns.name: State
columns.description: The state of the record: Published or Draft.

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: Unique user identifier for the owner of the record.

columns.name: Category
columns.description: The ID of the record's category.

columns.name: Method
columns.description: The ID of the record's method.

columns.name: CreditMinutes
columns.description: Number of minutes credited by the record.

columns.name: Evidence
columns.description: Comma delimited list of evidence file names.

columns.name: Type
columns.description: The type of the record: Structured or Unstructured.

columns.name: Grade
columns.description: The grade value of the associated award. Field can be null.

columns.name: DateCompleted
columns.description: The user provided date that the record was completed.

columns.name: LastModified
columns.description: The date and time (UTC) the record was added or last updated.

columns.name: DateDeleted
columns.description: The date and time (UTC) the method was deleted. Field can be null.

columns.name: Version
columns.description: Indicates the version of the row. This information is used to determine which table row occurred first.
